description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and the accuracy of different models on the BBQ dataset. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at intervals of 250 demonstrations. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and ranges from 45 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot includes four lines representing different models: Squared Exponential, Tanb, ELU, and LLLaMA-2-chat-7B. The Squared Exponential line is solid and colored blue, showing a slight increase in accuracy as the number of demonstrations increases, starting at an accuracy just above 50 and ending just below 55. The Tanb line is also solid and blue, with a more pronounced increase in accuracy, starting at an accuracy just below 50 and ending just above 55. The ELU line is dashed and colored blue, with a slight increase in accuracy, starting at an accuracy just below 50 and ending just above 50. The LLLaMA-2-chat-7B line is dashed and colored pink, with a slight increase in accuracy, starting at an accuracy just below 50 and ending just above 50.
